items.question: Can a change transaction commit after GET /sync/init returns a cursor later than the change row timestamp, causing the next strict-greater-than pull to miss it?
items.currentEvidence: sync.js performs entity queries before assigning serverTime cursor; R05 inherited B07 and documented the late-commit window as untested. No current-turn DB experiment.
items.missingInput: Owned isolated PostgreSQL instance, deterministic two-connection barrier, and captured SQL/response logs.
items.ownerRole: Audit executor with isolated database access
items.resolutionCondition: Run the protocol in protocol-questions.md and record timestamps, commit order, second-pull result, and cleanup evidence.
items.sourceReason: Database visibility/timestamp ordering cannot be established from static source alone.

items.question: Under two barrier-synchronized pushes with the same key and stale base, what are the final entity state and receipt status; can a later loser receipt overwrite the winner receipt?
items.currentEvidence: Successful receipt prefetch is outside the business write; existing-record updates use CAS; business write and receipt upsert are separate. Historical B06 tests post-write receipt failure, not same-key concurrency.
items.missingInput: Isolated DB, synthetic row, deterministic barrier at prefetch/read and before receipt upsert, and repeatable transaction logs.
items.ownerRole: Audit executor with isolated database access
items.resolutionCondition: Run a controlled two-request experiment including identical and divergent payloads; assert database row, both HTTP outcomes, and final SyncMutation contents.
items.sourceReason: Interleaving final state depends on database CAS/upsert scheduling and was not run.

items.question: After an HTTP 500 at each point around mutation write and receipt persistence, what stable client-visible recovery route resolves each outbox item?
items.currentEvidence: Historical B06 shows business write committed with missing receipt; frontend processes/removes outbox only after a successful push response; /sync/status exposes counts, not key-specific outcome lookup.
items.missingInput: Defined client recovery contract and targeted failure-point outcome evidence. Do not infer whole-batch atomicity.
items.ownerRole: Sync protocol owner and audit executor
items.resolutionCondition: Specify per-item retry/query semantics; if code behavior remains insufficiently evidenced, run isolated failure injection at business-write/receipt boundary and verify retry.
items.sourceReason: The historical single fault demonstrates ambiguity but does not cover every entity or recovery branch.

items.question: Does the deployed environment run a cleanup job for SyncMutation and expired MutationReceipt rows, and what is the effective replay/idempotency window?
items.currentEvidence: Targeted backend/src search found no SyncMutation cleanup call; receipts.js marks expiresAt and says cleanup is outside its scope. This does not rule out external scheduled jobs.
items.missingInput: Non-sensitive deployment scheduler/runbook and retention configuration.
items.resolutionCondition: Inspect the candidate deployment's scheduled jobs and document retention/deletion cadence and replay behavior after expiry.
items.sourceReason: Repository route/helper evidence alone cannot establish deployed external cleanup.

items.question: Should offline delete mutations conflict when their baseUpdatedAt is stale, and what should repeated tombstones return?
items.currentEvidence: sync.js excludes delete from the stale-base precheck and performs update by id; HTTP delete behavior follows a different route. No stale-delete probe or product rule was found in reviewed packet evidence.
items.missingInput: Business rule for delete-wins versus stale-delete conflict, plus explicit repeated-delete contract.
items.resolutionCondition: Record an approved deletion conflict/replay contract, then verify online and offline routes against it.
items.sourceReason: Static route difference alone does not establish unintended data loss without the expected conflict contract.

items.question: What is the required access-token invalidation time after self-service password change or administrator reset?
items.currentEvidence: R02/N-R02-02 statically confirms passwordChangedAt is not checked by access-token authentication; R02 records the policy timing question.
items.missingInput: Security/product-approved session invalidation SLA and separate self-service/admin reset expectations.
items.resolutionCondition: Resolve under S01 and append the decision reference to final reconciliation; this S03 item must not duplicate the finding.
items.sourceReason: S03 records cross-cutting dependency only; it does not decide security policy.

items.question: Must setting a project manager through any write entry point imply an active ProjectMember row with role MANAGER?
items.currentEvidence: R06 found HTTP manager transfer updates the project and membership relation transactionally while generic sync projects.managerId is a field update. This package inherited that matrix and did not rerun it.
items.missingInput: Approved product rule for managerId/member-role coupling and behavior when the prior manager is removed.
items.resolutionCondition: Resolve the relationship contract in S01, then compare HTTP/sync outcomes against it.
items.sourceReason: Current code behavior is known from R06; whether the behavior is contractually required is a pending business decision.

items.question: Do concurrent report version allocations or transaction isolation permit duplicate/incorrect version outcomes, and which source statuses may legally be resubmitted?
items.currentEvidence: R09 statically found max(version)+1 allocation inside command transaction and inherited a controlled stale snapshot probe. This S03 review confirms sync has no submit command; it did not run version-allocation contention.
items.missingInput: Owned isolated PostgreSQL and barrier-controlled concurrent submit scenario; product-approved valid resubmission source states.
items.ownerRole: Audit executor with isolated database access and report policy owner
items.resolutionCondition: Run simultaneous submits in the isolated DB and separately resolve legal source statuses with S01; record version uniqueness and transaction result.
items.sourceReason: Static code and the historic probe do not establish all isolation-level/version race outcomes or the intended resubmission policy.

items.question: Which supported task client versions send expectedUpdatedAt, and are stale writes rejected across every field/status/assignee entry?
items.currentEvidence: Two offline status UI paths pass task.updatedAt to outbox; online task PUT and PATCH routes do not parse/pass a client baseline. R09 historical probe established stale PUT overwrite. This package did not enumerate all deployed client versions or run per-field interleavings.
items.missingInput: Supported client/version contract and entry-point/field test matrix.
items.resolutionCondition: Enumerate supported clients and run the B16 acceptance matrix for ordinary fields, status, assignment, mixed PUT, and PATCH; retain legacy compatibility boundaries.
items.sourceReason: Current source establishes route DTO gap but does not identify all deployed clients or prove each stale-write outcome.

items.question: How many existing cross-project parent edges, orphans, cycles, and references to tombstoned parents exist, and what remediation policy applies?
currentEvidence: Current schema and initial migration permit a parent FK on task id only and define ON DELETE CASCADE.
No business database was queried; no anomaly count is known.
items.missingInput: A specifically authorized read-only database or isolated copy plus a product-approved disposition policy.
items.resolutionCondition: Run reviewed read-only counts on a verified permitted data source; approve data repair policy before any write or constraint migration.
items.sourceReason: No live or business data access was performed.
